name: Rush Tight extension 1
description: Rush column: at least 1,000 whole matches per flat cell, earlier knobs on. Tight uses 1,000 seeds both ways (2,000 matches) to resolve a borderline first sample; all other flat cells use 500 seeds both ways. Targets: Kick-chase 53–57%, All-out 43–47%, Tight/Expansive 48–52%. Fit rows use task 1 sheets and 200 seeds both ways (400 matches).
